podcast.body: Released in October 1969, this album by the sculptor-turned-musician was so unconventional that it immediately became an underground classic. Most listeners found its 28 songs "absolutely completely and undeniably un-listenable," yet many, including the future Johnny Rotten of the Sex Pistols, bought and played it specifically for its challenging nature. Even today, it remains a difficult listen but opened "new possibilities" for a few. "Most who heard this album, which is called Trout Mask Replica, found it to be absolutely completely and undeniably un-listenable."
